description: See Cursor included usage (Cursor models and other models) and on-demand spend in the status bar, and open a full usage dashboard (daily trends, model costs, activity by hour, past cycles). Data stays on your machine.
config.language: Display language for the status bar, alerts and dashboard
config.refreshSeconds: Auto refresh interval in seconds. A full sync with model details runs every 10 minutes. Increase it if the desktop app runs too, to avoid duplicate fetches.
config.statusBar: What the status bar item shows
config.statusBar.auto: Included usage while the other-models (API) pool lasts, then on-demand
config.alerts.enabled: Notify when usage crosses a threshold or will run out within 3 days at the current pace (once per level per cycle)
config.onDemandBudget: Personal on-demand budget in USD. When it is below the Cursor limit, alerts use it instead; 0 = off
config.stateDbPath: Path to Cursor's state.vscdb sign-in data; leave empty to find it automatically
